itemdesc-magnifyingglass: Reveals fingerprints left on chests, crates and the blocks beneath them.
handbook-text:
Anyone who opens a chest or crate leaves fingerprints on it. If the container is broken, the prints stay on the block it stood on.

To study a block, hold rightmouse on it with the magnifying glass in hand. While you hold the glass, chests and crates won't open, so you don't leave your own prints. Fresh prints are fully readable, old ones get smudged and eventually fade away.
